title: Black Box
description: Deduce where the hidden balls are by firing beams into the box and reading how each beam is deflected.
shortDescription: Use beam entry and exit clues to locate hidden balls.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a square on the arena edge to fire a beam. Click inside the arena to place or remove a guessed ball; right-click a square, row, or column to lock it against changes.
instructions: Fire beams from the edges and use their reflections and exit points to infer the hidden balls. Click inside the arena to mark guesses, then submit when ready. Right-click to lock squares, rows, or columns while solving.

title: Bridges
description: Connect every numbered island with horizontal or vertical bridges while matching each island’s bridge total.
shortDescription: Link numbered islands with single or double bridges.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click an island and drag toward a neighboring island to add a bridge. Repeat to cycle through double and no bridge; click without dragging to mark an island complete.
instructions: Connect all islands into one network. Each island must have exactly the number of bridge ends shown, bridges may not cross, and single or double bridges are allowed.

title: Cube
description: Roll a cube across a grid to collect blue squares on its faces, swapping colors at each landing.
shortDescription: Roll the cube to collect every blue square.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Use the arrow keys to roll, or click in the direction you want the cube to move.
instructions: Collect all blue squares on the cube’s faces at once, using as few moves as possible. Each roll swaps the color of the cube face and grid square that meet.

title: Dominosa
description: Tile the numbered rectangle with dominoes so every possible pair of numbers, including doubles, appears once.
shortDescription: Place every number-pair domino exactly once.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click between two adjacent numbers to place or remove a domino. Right-click an edge to mark that a domino cannot go there.
instructions: Cover the board with dominoes so every possible pair of numbers appears exactly once. Repeated dominoes are highlighted.

title: Fifteen
description: Slide numbered tiles into ascending order, leaving the empty square at the bottom right.
shortDescription: Slide the tiles into numerical order.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a tile next to the empty square to slide it.
instructions: Slide tiles into the empty space until the numbers are in order from the top left, with the hole at the bottom right.

title: Filling
description: Fill every square with a number so each connected group of identical numbers has an area equal to that number.
shortDescription: Fill the grid with numbered groups of matching area.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click or drag to select blank squares, then type a number. Select filled squares and press Backspace to erase.
instructions: Write a number in every square. Each orthogonally connected group of the same number must contain exactly that many squares; for example, each 1 stands alone and each 2 belongs to a pair.

title: Flip
description: Turn on every square by flipping selected squares together with the neighbors shown by their diagrams.
shortDescription: Flip squares and their neighbors to light the grid.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a square to flip it and the neighboring squares indicated by its diagram.
instructions: Light every square by clicking squares that flip themselves and the neighbors indicated in their diagrams. Try the random puzzle types for more variety.

title: Flood
description: Flood-fill the top-left region until the entire grid is one color, staying within the move limit.
shortDescription: Flood the board with one color in limited moves.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click any square to flood-fill the top-left region with that square’s color.
instructions: Repeatedly flood-fill the top-left corner with a new color to absorb adjacent regions. Make the whole board one color within the move limit.

title: Galaxies
description: Partition the grid into connected regions that are rotationally symmetric around one centered dot each.
shortDescription: Draw symmetric regions around the dots.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a grid edge to add or remove a boundary. Right-drag from a dot to place or move an arrow marking a square in its region.
instructions: Divide the grid into connected regions. Each region must contain exactly one dot at its center, be symmetric under a half-turn around that dot, and have no internal boundary lines.

title: Guess
description: Crack the hidden color sequence using feedback that reports correct colors and positions after each guess.
shortDescription: Deduce the hidden color sequence from peg clues.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Drag colors from the left into the topmost empty row, then click the small circles to submit the guess.
instructions: Use the black feedback pegs for correct colors in the correct positions and white pegs for correct colors in different positions to refine each guess.

title: Inertia
description: Guide a sliding ball through the grid to collect every gem while avoiding mines and using stop squares to control movement.
shortDescription: Slide through the maze, collect gems, and avoid mines.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Use the numeric keypad to move horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, or click the grid in the direction you want the ball to travel.
instructions: The ball keeps sliding until it hits a wall or a stop square. Collect every gem without hitting a mine; use Undo after a collision if needed.

title: Keen
description: Fill each row and column with unique digits while satisfying the arithmetic target in every cage.
shortDescription: Solve an arithmetic Latin-square puzzle.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a square and type a digit. Right-click a square and type a digit to toggle it as a pencil mark; select a square and press Backspace to erase.
instructions: Use digits from 1 to the grid size exactly once in every row and column. Each outlined cage must produce its target using the displayed arithmetic operation.

title: Light Up
description: Place lamps to illuminate every blank square without any lamp illuminating another.
shortDescription: Illuminate the grid while obeying numbered walls.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a square to toggle a lamp. Right-click to mark a square as having no lamp.
instructions: A lamp lights its square and every unobstructed square in the same row and column. Lamps cannot light one another, and each numbered wall must touch exactly that many lamps.

title: Loopy
description: Draw one closed loop along grid edges so each numbered cell has exactly that many loop edges.
shortDescription: Trace a single loop that satisfies the clues.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Left-click a grid edge to include it in the loop or cycle it back to undecided. Right-click to mark an edge as excluded.
instructions: Form one closed loop from the grid edges. Each numbered square must have exactly the indicated number of its edges in the loop.

title: Magnets
description: Fill each domino with a magnet or neutral tile so the positive and negative row and column totals match.
shortDescription: Place magnets to match every line total.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Left-click an empty square to place a magnet with its positive pole there; click again to reverse it, then again to remove it. Right-click to cycle an empty domino through blank, unknown magnet orientation, and empty. Click a clue to mark it done.
instructions: Match the positive and negative pole totals shown for every row and column. Positive poles cannot touch other positive poles orthogonally, and negative poles cannot touch other negative poles. Use blank dominoes or unknown-orientation marks to record deductions.

title: Map
description: Color each map region with one of four colors so bordering regions differ; the given clues determine a unique coloring.
shortDescription: Color the map so neighboring regions differ.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Drag from a colored region to a blank region to copy its color. Drag from outside the grid into a region to clear it; right-drag between regions to mark a possible same-color pair.
instructions: Color every region with one of four colors so regions that share a border differ. Regions that touch only at a corner are not adjacent, and the given colors cannot be changed.

title: Mines
description: Reveal every safe cell using neighboring mine counts, and flag the cells you believe contain mines.
shortDescription: Clear safe cells using mine-count clues.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a cell to reveal it; right-click to flag a suspected mine. Click a numbered cell with the correct surrounding flag count to reveal its unflagged neighbors.
instructions: Reveal all cells without mines. Numbers show the mines in neighboring cells; flags mark suspected mines. The first opened cell is safe.

title: Mosaic
description: Color each square black or white; each clue gives the number of black squares in its surrounding 3×3 area, including itself.
shortDescription: Reconstruct the picture from local count clues.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Left-click an empty square to make it black; right-click to make it white. Click a filled square to cycle through black, white, and empty; drag to mark multiple squares.
instructions: Use each number to count the black cells in its surrounding 3×3 area, including the clue cell. Fill every square black or white.

title: Net
description: Rotate the wire tiles into one connected network with no loops, so every square connects to the center.
shortDescription: Rotate tiles to connect the whole network.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Left-click a tile to rotate it counterclockwise; right-click to rotate clockwise. Middle-click or Shift-click to lock or unlock a tile.
instructions: Rotate tiles until every square is part of one connected network with no loops. Connected squares light up from the center.

title: Palisade
description: Draw boundaries that form connected regions of the indicated size while giving every numbered square its required number of edges.
shortDescription: Partition the grid into regions that fit the clues.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Click a grid edge to cycle between boundary and undecided; right-click to mark it as definitely not a boundary.
instructions: Divide the grid into connected regions of the size shown in the status line. Every numbered square must have exactly that many drawn edges.

title: Pearl
description: Draw one closed loop through the grid that obeys the corner rules for black pearls and straight-line rules for white pearls.
shortDescription: Draw a loop that obeys every pearl clue.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Drag between neighboring squares or left-click their shared edge to toggle a loop segment. Right-click an edge to mark it excluded.
instructions: Draw one closed loop. Black pearls must be corners not directly connected to another corner; white pearls must be straight segments connected to at least one corner.

title: Pegs
description: Jump pegs over other pegs into empty holes until only one peg remains.
shortDescription: Jump pegs to clear the board.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Drag a peg into an empty hole exactly two spaces away in a straight orthogonal direction, jumping over a peg.
instructions: Each legal jump removes the peg that was jumped over. Continue until only one peg remains.

title: Range
description: Mark black squares so numbered cells see the required total of white squares without disconnecting the white area.
shortDescription: Shade cells while keeping clues’ lines of sight.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Left-click a square to mark it black. Right-click to place a dot on a square that must not be black.
instructions: Black squares cannot touch orthogonally, and the remaining white squares must stay connected. Each numbered cell must see exactly its clue number of white squares across all four directions, counting itself; black squares block sight.

title: Rectangles
description: Partition the grid into rectangles, each containing one clue whose number equals that rectangle’s area.
shortDescription: Draw clue-sized rectangles across the grid.
licenseNotes: Simon Tatham’s Portable Puzzle Collection, copyright Simon Tatham and contributors; MIT License. License text included at /play/LICENSE.txt.
controls: Drag from one grid corner or square center to another to draw a rectangle. You can also draw or erase individual grid edges.
instructions: Divide the grid into rectangles so each contains exactly one numbered square and has an area equal to that number.

description: Slide numbered tiles together, combine matching values, and reach the 2048 tile.
shortDescription: Join matching number tiles to reach 2048.
licenseNotes: Copyright 2014 Gabriele Cirulli; MIT License. Full game source and license are included locally.
controls: Use arrow keys or swipe to slide all tiles. Matching tiles merge.
instructions: Slide the tiles to combine matching numbers and create a 2048 tile. The game ends when no moves remain.

title: Hextris
description: Rotate the central hexagon to catch matching colored blocks and keep the stack from reaching the edge.
shortDescription: Rotate the hexagon and match falling blocks.
developer: Logan Engstrom, Garrett Finucane, Noah Moroze, and Michael Yang
licenseNotes: Copyright 2018 Logan Engstrom; GPL-3.0-or-later. Full source and LICENSE.md are included locally. Third-party components remain under their own licenses; remote advertising script was removed.
controls: Left/right arrows or A/D rotate; down/S speeds blocks; P or Space pauses. Touch left or right half to rotate.
instructions: Rotate the hexagon to align incoming blocks of the same color. Clear blocks before the stack reaches the outer edge.

title: Stack

licenseNotes: Original public CodePen contains an explicit MIT grant. Copyright notice preserved in LICENSE.txt and game.js. Sidequest adds unified pointer input and an official Three.js MIT CanvasRenderer fallback; core gameplay unchanged.
controls: Space, click, or tap to place a block.
instructions: Press Start, then time each drop to align with the tower. Overhanging pieces are cut away. Miss the tower and the game ends. Click or press Space to restart.
